concurrent_settings: Each adapter serializes its complete registry read/apply transaction. integer_width.contract: Scaler products, fractions and saturated results use checked 32-bit arithmetic, including the full int32 input range. Layer clocks use uint32 milliseconds and explicit pending-deadline state, so a deadline of zero after wrap is valid. Half-range deadline ordering assumes delays/observations below 2^31 ms; long silent spans can be ambiguous. The typing guard conservatively suppresses a timestamp interpreted as future.

integer_width.timeout_boundary: Native32 divisions at all clock rates; configured k_ticks_t width retained for final product. Private helper supports fulluint32 remaining duration while public60000ms validation and half-range deadline semantics remain unchanged.
